notes.title: Small Fixes, Shiny Fish, and Global Penguins — Demo Update is Live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 🐧

We just pushed a fresh update to the demo with a bunch of little improvements and fixes. Here’s what changed while we were definitely not just sliding around for fun:

Valuable fish are now a bit harder to catch. Gotta earn those coins!

There’s a new sign in the village that shows the names of all players. Yes, you’re famous now.

Fixed a bug that was causing chaos in some mini-games.

Items you sell now properly leave your inventory. No more ghost bananas.

Fish you catch now glow based on their value. Shiny fish are good fish.

Lobbies now show which country they’re hosted in. Global penguin party.

Private rooms now appear in the list, but you still need an invite or a code to join them.

You’ll no longer see your own name in the messages tab. Mystery solved.

Added localization for some previously silent objects.

General optimization work to keep things smooth and cozy.

As always, thanks for playing and for all the feedback you’ve been sending. More updates are on the way!

With love,
The Penguins at CO’s Entertainment 🐟
